name: Therapy (Modern)
tagline: A modern template for online therapy practices — book sessions from day one.
description: A clean, modern teletherapy site — a soft-indigo palette, a warm accent and a modern sans, built for accessible online mental-wellness care. Installs a working booking flow: a free matching call plus individual, stress & burnout, and professional-wellness sessions, three therapists you book by name with evening and weekend hours, and a no-show hold policy. Ships as "Clearmind Therapy", an online-first practice you can book in about a minute.
